title: ops_findings inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the platform-operations findings tool (advertised name honua_ops_findings). Read-only over the deterministic ops findings surface (mirror of GET /api/v1/admin/observability/findings). Two modes: omit findingId to LIST the active findings (server-ordered by descending severity), optionally narrowed by severity and rule; provide findingId to GET a single finding by its deterministic identifier. Each finding carries a recommendedAction {kind, summary, reason} and evidence references; the action is proposed (never executed) by finding id through the operation gateway, consistent with the honua-server ADR-0028 no-direct-AI-mutation posture. The response payload is the honua://ops/findings resource projection (see resources/ops-findings.schema.json). x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

findingId.description: Deterministic finding identifier to fetch a single finding (get mode). When omitted, the tool lists active findings (list mode).

severity.description: Optional list-mode filter: return only findings at this severity.

rule.description: Optional list-mode filter: return only findings produced by this kebab-case rule identifier.
